sketchfab.appliesTo: Standard and Editorial licences sold on the Sketchfab Store. The Store no longer sells: sketchfab.com/store redirects to the home page ("Buy & sell 3D models on Fab") and every paid model checked has inStore false.
sketchfab.answer: No explicit permission for real-time or web delivery. The grant is a general licence to "Reproduce", but 2.2(b) and 2.2(h) forbid making the model available so third parties can download, extract or access it as a stand-alone file, 2.7 requires posting terms that prohibit that, and 12 requires "a robust firewall". A plain GLB fetched by the browser from a public URL fails this.

quotes.2.2(b): sell, license, distribute or otherwise make available the Licensed Material as a stand-alone file (or group of files) or in a way that allows third parties to use, download, extract or access the Licensed Material as a stand-alone file (or group of files);
quotes.2.2(h): make the Licensed Material available in a manner intended to allow or invite a third party to download, extract, redistribute or access the Licensed Material as a stand-alone file (or group of files);
quotes.2.7: Licensee shall post terms and conditions on its permitted websites that prohibit, republication, retransmission, reproduction or other use of the Licensed Material as a stand-alone file (or group of files).
quotes.12: Licensee may not make additional high-resolution copies of the Licensed Material, and Licensee shall maintain a robust firewall to safeguard against unauthorized third-party access to the Licensed Material.
quotes.2.3 (Editorial): your License is further conditioned upon you not using, and you agree not to use, the Editorial Licensed Material for any (a) commercial, promotional, endorsement, advertising or merchandising use ... nor (c) purpose other than to create a Licensee Work that comments on or criticizes (i) the subject matter of the Licensed Material; or (ii) newsworthy or public interest events associated with the Licensed Material
quotes.summary (Editorial): those assets (a) cannot be used for any commercial or promotional use; (b) cannot be used to suggest sponsorship, affiliation, or association with any person, brand, or company; and (c) can be used in only works that comment on or criticize the subject matter

cgtrader.answer: Not explicit for websites. Games are allowed "if the Product is contained inside a proprietary format", apps and platforms only if the model "is not downloadable by users ... in the form in which it is downloaded from the Site", and 21A.3 requires "commercially reasonable measures to prevent the end user from gaining access" (proprietary format, protected resource file, or encryption). An optimised GLB in a public repo is an open, extractable format: unclear at best, likely a breach. Ordinary buyers only get "Royalty Free License, No AI" (21A.7); No AI only adds a ban on ML training (21B.1), which does not affect Swap Lab, but CLAUDE.md rule 5 currently excludes it.

quotes.8 (definition): Incorporated Product – Product that cannot be extracted from an application or other product, services, creative works, research, content, data, or other value-added materials, and used as a stand-alone object without the use of reverse engineering tools or techniques.
quotes.21A.2 (games): as purchased by a game’s creators as part of a game if the Product is contained inside a proprietary format and displays inside the game during play
quotes.21A.2 (apps/platforms): provided that a) Product is not downloadable by users of such virtual worlds, metaverses, applications or platforms in the form in which it is downloaded from the Site
quotes.21A.3: If you use any Product in software products (such as video games, simulations, or VR-worlds) you must take all commercially reasonable measures to prevent the end user from gaining access to the Product. Methods of safeguarding the Product include but are not limited to: using a proprietary disc format ...; using a proprietary Product format; using a proprietary and/or password protected database or resource file that stores the Product data; encrypting the Product data.
quotes.21A.7: Products uploaded by Sellers with a Royalty Free License may be made available for purchase on the Site under Royalty Free License, No AI. Products with a Royalty Free License may be available for the Buyers only if purchased as part of Bulk Enterprise Sales ... or Custom Enterprise Deals
quotes.21B.1: The same licensing terms apply as for Royalty Free License, except that Product use for machine learning or training of neural network models, including generative AI models, is not permitted.
quotes.22.2 (Editorial): Buyers may only use Products marked “editorial” or “editorial license” for legitimate, editorial purposes on some issue of journalistic, editorial, cultural or otherwise newsworthy value.
quotes.listing popup: Royalty Free License ... Redistribution: Selling or re-uploading the file. AI Use: Training or fine-tuning AI models. (shown as not included) ... Need an AI-friendly license? Contact our sales team for Enterprise data licensing options.

turbosquid.effective: "This 3D Model License is effective for use with 3D Models for use on or after March 16, 2023."

turbosquid.explicitRealTimeWebPermission: Only for Unity, Unreal and Lumberyard WebGL exports; anything else needs advance written approval.
turbosquid.answer: No for Swap Lab as built (three.js loading GLB). 7(b) requires proprietary formats that cannot be opened in public software, permits WebGL only from Unity/Unreal/Lumberyard, and prohibits "any other open format". Other WebGL use needs TurboSquid's prior approval and a non-standard format or substantially modified mesh and textures. Editorial models: no commercial, non-news purpose at all.

quotes.7 (permitted): you may incorporate 3D Models in Creations of Computer Games, virtual worlds, simulation and training environments; mobile, desktop and web applications
quotes.7(b): You must take all reasonable and industry standard measures to incorporate 3D Models within Creations to prevent other parties from gaining access to 3D Models. 3D Models must be contained in proprietary formats so that they cannot be opened or imported in a publicly available software application or framework, or extracted without reverse engineering. WebGL exports from Unity, Unreal, and Lumberyard are permitted. Any other open format or format encrypted with decryptable open standards (such as an encrypted compression archive or other WebGL programs not listed here) are prohibited from using 3D Models.
quotes.FAQ (WebGL): TurboSquid allows content to be used in WebGL applications IF the customer/application converts the content from the DCC format to a JavaScript/other non-standard format prior to porting to the WebGL program, subject to the following guidelines: A) the format has no known reverse engineering methods and/or B) The textures and topology of the mesh have been modified in such a way to make it a substantially different product. These uses must be approved in advance by contacting us through email or our Support channels.
quotes.4 (Editorial): Permitted use of Depicted Intellectual Property in such 3D Models is limited to news reporting in Creations of some cultural, editorial, journalistic, or otherwise newsworthy value, including news reporting on television and the internet. A second permitted use is use within an academic setting, limited to teaching, scholarship, and research.
quotes.FAQ (Editorial not allowed): Merchandising . No physical product for resale, video game, etc. ... Commercial Purpose. No commercial, non-news related purpose.
